title: Only 7% Pass This Oxford Entrance Exam
summary: Explore Tutorial Foundations, Evidence & Argument, Logic at the Board, Interview Trapdoors, The Final Tutorial across five six-question rounds.

landing.intro:
Read the clues. Make the connections.
Put your thinking to the test.

about.body:
Five rounds offer different angles on this challenge: Tutorial Foundations, Evidence & Argument, Logic at the Board, Interview Trapdoors, The Final Tutorial. Each round contains six distinct questions.

Choose one of four answers and move on automatically. There is no time limit. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, each next round and the final result. The target is 24 correct answers out of 30. The result describes this quiz attempt only.

Independent entertainment challenge. Not an official Oxford admissions test and not affiliated with any university.

steps: Press Start, watch a short rewarded ad and begin.
Choose one answer per question and progress through five rounds.
Complete all 30 questions to reveal your result. You can then unlock the full breakdown.

oxford-s1q1.question: ARCHIVE is to RECORDS as ANTHOLOGY is to…

oxford-s1q3.question: All fellows attend tutorials. Nia is a fellow. What must follow?

oxford-s1q4.question: A rule says only badge holders may enter. Omar has a badge. What can you conclude?

answers.a3: The rule alone does not show whether Omar entered

oxford-s1q5.question: Which word is closest in meaning to CONCISE?

oxford-s1q6.question: A book costs £24 after a 20% reduction. What was its original price?

oxford-s2q1.question: Which conclusion follows? No poets are careless editors. Some reviewers are poets.

answers.a1: Some reviewers are not careless editors

oxford-s2q2.question: A survey records 70 tutorial users and 50 library users among 100 students. Both or neither were allowed. What is the exact overlap?

oxford-s2q3.question: Which evidence best tests whether a new reading list improved essay quality?

answers.a1: Students say the list looks modern
answers.a2: Compare essays using the old and new lists under similar marking conditions
answers.a3: Count the books on each list
answers.a4: Ask one tutor which list they prefer

oxford-s2q4.question: If an argument says a longer library day will increase attendance, which assumption does it need?

answers.a4: Some students who cannot attend now would use the added hours

oxford-s2q5.question: Which example disproves the claim ‘Every prime number is odd’?

oxford-s2q6.question: A seminar has 18 students. Two thirds submit early. How many submit early?

oxford-s3q1.question: A is before B. C is after B. Which order must be correct?

oxford-s3q2.question: What is the next difference in this pattern?

oxford-s3q3.question: Exactly one statement is true. A says ‘B is true.’ B says ‘A and C are false.’ C says ‘B is false.’ Who is true?

oxford-s3q4.question: A tutorial begins at 14:35 and lasts 1 hour 45 minutes. When does it finish?

oxford-s3q5.question: Every submitted essay was marked. This essay was marked. What follows?

answers.a3: Nothing proves that it was submitted

oxford-s3q7.question: A marker starts in the top-left corner of a square. After a 180° rotation, where does it finish?

oxford-s4q1.question: A study finds students who sleep more score higher. What can it establish by itself?

answers.a4: Every student should sleep the same amount

oxford-s4q2.question: The average of 6, 10, 14 and x is 12. What is x?

oxford-s4q3.question: Which question exposes missing information in ‘Most students prefer tutorials’?

answers.a2: How many students were asked and how were they selected?

oxford-s4q4.question: A candidate must submit a form and a reference. Mei submitted a form only. What follows?

answers.a3: Mei has not yet met the stated requirement

oxford-s4q5.question: ARGUMENT is to CONCLUSION as CALCULATION is to…

oxford-s4q6.question: A 240-page book is read at 30 pages per day. After five days, how many pages remain?

oxford-s5q1.question: Every shortlisted candidate passed Logic. Some candidates who passed Logic were not shortlisted. Which statement must be true?

answers.a1: Everyone who passed Logic was shortlisted
answers.a2: At least one Logic passer was not shortlisted

oxford-s5q2.question: A code adds 2, then doubles. Starting with 7, what result appears after both steps?

oxford-s5q3.question: Three essays—History, Law and Music—are presented Monday to Wednesday. Law is after History. Music is not Wednesday. What is Monday?

oxford-s5q4.question: A report says 80% of 50 respondents agreed. How many agreed, and what limitation remains?

answers.a1: 40; the sample may not represent everyone

oxford-s5q6.question: A library adds evening hours and visits rise. Which comparison best separates the hours effect from a seasonal rise?

answers.a1: Compare with a similar library that kept its hours during the same period
answers.a2: Ask visitors if they like evenings

oxford-s5q7.question: A rule admits applicants with Logic ≥ 80 and Writing ≥ 70. Ava scores 84/68; Bo scores 79/90; Cy scores 82/74. Who qualifies?
